messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — onboarding KB (docs/onboarding/getting-started.md) has a curl block that's getting folded into the paragraph on the site; copy-paste fails for the curl command.

maya: Repro snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

sam: can you drop the doc link?

maya: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/getting-started

alex: I can take this — looks like the markdown block isn't separated by blank lines from the preceding paragraph. Quick fix is to add a blank line before the triple backticks or wrap with HTML <pre>.

jamie: I can open the PR if you want @alex, will add a tiny note in the changelog too.

docs-bot: Owner lookup: docs owner for onboarding/getting-started.md => @alex (via CODEOWNERS). I'll add a reviewer ping when PR is opened.

jamie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

sam: thx! can you include a test that renders the MD in the site preview? last time we missed it.

jamie: added CI preview step; test passes locally. cc @maya

maya: awesome — can we merge before EOD? small change.

alex: LGTM, approved. I'll merge once CI green.

docs-bot: Deploy preview available: https://staging.redwood.docs/preview/482 (renders OK)

jamie: merged and cherry-picked to main. :thumbsup:

maya: thank you!
